ns2:course.label: Indoor Air Quality Engineering
ns2:course.description: (AG E 360) Principles and applications of indoor air quality. Topics include particle mechanics, gas kinetics, air quality sampling principles and techniques, air cleaning technologies (i.e. filters, cyclones, electrostatic precipitation) for indoor environments, and ventilation effectiveness. Includes laboratory. Prerequisite: PHYS 213, MATH 385, TAM 335 or equivalent.
